entry.title: Cable Advisory Committee: the meeting of 13 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Cable committee began Comcast license-renewal review, dividing up outreach tasks ahead of hiring counsel. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gIzjXrZwjYA), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
